Multi-modal cervical physical therapy may have a positive effect on subjective tinnitus complaints in patients with a combination of tinnitus and neck complaints. To further understand its impact, larger studies that use more responsive outcome measures are necessary to prove this effect.

In other words, while multi-modal cervical physical therapy has shown promise in addressing symptoms such as neck pain, there is currently limited evidence to support its effectiveness specifically for improving tinnitus in patients with cervicogenic somatic tinnitus. However, further research is needed to confirm its potential benefits and understand the underlying mechanisms.
